stories.canonicalTitle: BIS issues interim final rule expanding export controls to mid-tier AI accelerators via performance-density threshold
stories.whySelected: The rule changes which accelerators require licences and creates a near-term compliance deadline for vendors, buyers and existing orders.

stories.canonicalTitle: Quarrystone releases security patches 17.4 and 16.8 fixing unauthenticated WAL exposure flaw CVE-2026-41882
stories.whySelected: The flaw can expose complete write-ahead logs without authentication under a common configuration, making immediate patch and configuration review actionable.

stories.canonicalTitle: Northbridge us-east-2 control plane disruption blocks instance launches and scaling for six hours
stories.whySelected: The post-incident evidence identifies certificate rotation as the cause of a major regional control-plane failure and clarifies the affected operations.

stories.canonicalTitle: Sable ORM 6.2.0 bug causes silent row loss during batched upserts
stories.whySelected: A reproducible silent-data-loss defect in a current ORM release warrants immediate version and workload checks by affected teams.

stories.canonicalTitle: Financial Stability Board mandates daily reserve attestation and 80% overnight holdings for major stablecoin issuers
stories.whySelected: The final rule materially changes reserve composition, disclosure cadence and compliance obligations for systemically large payment stablecoins.

stories.canonicalTitle: Distance-9 surface code logical qubit demonstrates sustained below-threshold operation across one million cycles
stories.whySelected: The experiment updates the demonstrated durability boundary for quantum error correction, though it remains a preprint-stage research result.

stories.canonicalTitle: Reports emerge of unannounced Meridian model with two-million-token context window
stories.whySelected: If confirmed, the reported context capability would shift long-document model expectations; it remains explicitly unconfirmed and should be framed as a rumor.

stories.canonicalTitle: Vantiq Systems cuts full-year revenue guidance by 9% citing enterprise renewal slippage
stories.whySelected: The filing points to delayed multi-year renewals and weaker retention, a potentially useful signal on enterprise software spending rather than isolated churn.

stories.canonicalTitle: Aperture Research releases Nimbus-7 72B MoE weights with commercial serving restrictions
stories.whySelected: The weight release expands deployable model capability while its licence creates a material distinction between internal use and third-party serving.

stories.canonicalTitle: Rust 1.94 released with parallel front end enabled by default
stories.whySelected: A default compiler-path change can affect build performance and stability across the Rust ecosystem and is backed by official release material.

stories.canonicalTitle: Linux 6.19 merges deadline-aware fair scheduler rework
stories.whySelected: The scheduler rework changes a foundational kernel mechanism for latency-sensitive workloads and has reached the mainline merge window.

stories.canonicalTitle: Study finds rack-level power capping causes 11% accelerator idle time in production clusters
stories.whySelected: Production-cluster measurements suggest power delivery, not only scheduling, is already constraining effective accelerator utilisation.

stories.canonicalTitle: Anvil Data Centres defers two campus builds citing substation energisation delays to 2029
stories.whySelected: The disclosed project deferrals provide concrete evidence that grid interconnection queues are delaying new compute capacity.

stories.canonicalTitle: US initial jobless claims hold steady at 214,000
stories.whySelected: The official weekly release is useful for continuity in the macro ledger but does not materially alter the labor-market picture.

stories.canonicalTitle: Ashgrove Utilities declares quarterly dividend of 0.42 dollars per share
stories.whySelected: The filing is authoritative but records an unchanged routine dividend, so it is retained mainly for historical comparison.

emergingSignals.label: AI and compute growth is colliding with power delivery constraints
emergingSignals.rationale: Independent evidence appears at both operating and construction layers: production accelerators lose useful time to rack power caps, while new data-centre campuses are deferred by substation energisation queues. Together they suggest power availability is becoming a direct capacity and utilisation constraint rather than a distant planning issue.

curatorNotes: Submitted 13 actionable A/B stories plus two C-tier continuity records. The date-stamped duplicate jobless-claims story was intentionally excluded in favor of the stable slug. The Meridian item remains low-confidence rumor; routine crypto price snapshots and other feed noise were excluded during item review.
